mapper.insert: INSERT INTO opc_insight_daily_report ( company_id, period, summary_md, kpi_json, advice_md, llm_used, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{period}, #{summaryMd}, #{kpiJson}, #{adviceMd}, #{llmUsed}, #{createBy}, COALESCE(#{createTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{updateBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT id, company_id, DATE_FORMAT(period, '%Y-%m-%d') AS period, summary_md, kpi_json, advice_md, llm_used, create_time FROM opc_insight_daily_report WHERE id = #{id}
